title: Jason Dennis Wright — direct coauthors for V1 and V2
description: One row per distinct direct T2 neighbor of A5057686070 among the selected 80 researchers. Exact match on either endpoint, self excluded, no additional threshold. T1 display names and T2 distinct shared 2021–2024 snapshot work counts. Validated against T4 degree and the incident T12 edges.
code:
import json
sid = 'A5057686070'
nodes, edges, deg, routed = [load(x) for x in ('T1','T2','T4','T12')]
cols = ['source_author_id','target_author_id','shared_snapshot_work_count']
def incident(df):
    return df.loc[(df.source_author_id.eq(sid) | df.target_author_id.eq(sid)) & df.source_author_id.ne(df.target_author_id), cols].copy()
e = incident(edges)
r = incident(routed)
assert nodes.author_id.is_unique and (nodes.author_id == sid).sum() == 1
assert e.sort_values(cols).reset_index(drop=True).equals(r.sort_values(cols).reset_index(drop=True))
e['author_id'] = e.target_author_id.where(e.source_author_id.eq(sid), e.source_author_id)
assert e.author_id.is_unique
out = e[['author_id','shared_snapshot_work_count']].merge(nodes[['author_id','display_name']], on='author_id', how='left', validate='one_to_one')
assert out.display_name.notna().all()
check = deg.loc[deg.author_id.eq(sid)].iloc[0]
assert len(out) == check.degree and out.shared_snapshot_work_count.sum() == check.weighted_degree
out = out[['author_id','display_name','shared_snapshot_work_count']].sort_values(['shared_snapshot_work_count','author_id'], ascending=[False,True]).reset_index(drop=True)
out.insert(0,'type','author')
print('Source matches:', int(e.source_author_id.eq(sid).sum()), 'Target matches:', int(e.target_author_id.eq(sid).sum()), 'T4 degree:', check.degree, 'Weighted:', check.weighted_degree)
print(out.to_string(index=False))
print(json.dumps(out[['type','author_id']].rename(columns={'author_id':'id'}).to_dict('records')))
print(save_table(out, 'Jason Dennis Wright — direct coauthors for V1 and V2', 'One row per distinct direct T2 neighbor of A5057686070 among the selected 80 researchers. Exact match on either endpoint, self excluded, no additional threshold. T1 display names and T2 distinct shared 2021–2024 snapshot work counts. Validated against T4 degree and the incident T12 edges.'))
